name: directory
title: Diocese of Erie parish and church directory
command: pnpm diocese roster import erie directory scratch/map-erie/raw/directory.json
notes: Scraped 2026-10-23 by scratch/map-erie/tools/scrape_directory.py from three eriercd.org sources keyed by one numeric id: the alphabetical list parish-church.php (124 cards), the Find Parish/School locator JSON (doegetjson.php, 119 records with coordinates, descrip Parish/Mission/Church and a GroupID naming the record's parent or linked parish) and the List by city page directoryparishesandchurches.html (secondary churches under their parish, 'partnered with' pairs). One entry per directory record (parishes and churches alike, so a parish entry is also its main church). group = the locator GroupID's record name, else the city list's parent. Four city-list records (Holy Family Erie, Our Lady of Fatima Corry/Union City, St. Brigid Meadville, St. Joseph under Smethport) have detail pages that 302 to index.php: inactive records with no address. Pastor fields disagree between the locator, the detail pages and each other (e.g. St. Bernard, Bradford: Gramata vs Jacquel); do not use them for shared pastors. Mass times are the directory's, not a bulletin.
